title: api.v4.RunForCreate
description: Run represents an external CI/CD run from a third-party tool.

scmRef.description: The SCM ref for this run; can be a branch, a tag, etc. Must use the full git ref format (e.g.: refs/heads/main)

workflowName.description: the name of the workflow that is being executed

runNumber.description: run number, uniquely identifies an execution of a workflow

toolType.description:
CI/CD tool that produced this run; accepted values: ARGO_CD, CLOUDBEES_CI, HARNESS, JENKINS, UNIFY, CLOUDBEES, GITHUB
 This field will default to UNKNOWN if the tool doesn't match one of the accepted values

runAttempt.description: run attempt, used in engines like GitHub Actions to distinguish between multiple executions of a workflow

url.description: run URL in the original external system

trigger.description: what triggered the run; accepted values: PUSH, PULL_REQUEST, WORKFLOW_DISPATCH, SCHEDULE

actorEmail.description: email address of the user who triggered the run

status.description: run status; accepted values: PENDING, PAUSED, STARTED, FAILED, ERRORED, ABORTED, SUCCEEDED, PENDING_APPROVAL, TIMED_OUT, APPROVED, REJECTED, APPROVAL_TIMED_OUT, SKIPPED, UNSCHEDULED, UNSTABLE

statusMessage.description: run status message (normally specifying the failure cause)

changeRequestTitle.description: title of the change request that triggered the run

changeRequestTargetBranch.description: target branch of the change request

commitSha.description: commit SHA that triggered the run

commitMessage.description: commit message of the commit that triggered the run. The value of this field, if present, overrides change_request_title

externalParentFlow.description: external system identifier to group related runs under a common pipeline or workflow

statusReason.description:
status_reason is "POLICY" when a policy gate caused the current status, otherwise empty.
 Note: CloudBees-native runs never report PENDING_APPROVAL as their run status on this API,
 so in practice this identifies a policy-caused failure.
